Career Development

Continuing Education Resources

Stay current, stay credentialed. Browse our curated list of free and paid CE resources for healthcare professionals.

Quick Apply Contact Us

InSync Consulting Services is committed to supporting the ongoing education and career growth of the healthcare professionals we place. Below are trusted resources across multiple disciplines to help you maintain licensure and advance your practice.

General

General Healthcare Resources

Foundational resources from government agencies and global health organizations.

U.S. Dept. of Health & Human Services

Federal agency overseeing national health policy, grant programs, and healthcare regulatory guidance.

 hhs.gov

U.S. Dept. of State — Travel

Passport, visa, and international travel resources for healthcare professionals working abroad or relocating.

 travel.state.gov

U.S. Citizenship & Immigration Services

Official resource for work visa applications, green card processes, and immigration forms for healthcare workers.

 uscis.gov

World Health Organization

Global health data, clinical guidelines, and public health standards from the leading international health authority.

 who.int
Medicine

Medicine & Physician Resources

CME and continuing education platforms trusted by physicians and advanced practice providers.

AMA Ed Hub

The American Medical Association's platform for CME, MOC, and professional development courses for physicians.

 edhub.ama-assn.org

Medical Education Resources

Accredited CME provider offering case-based learning, live events, and online courses for healthcare providers.

 mer.org
Nursing

Nursing Continuing Education

Accredited CE platforms designed for RNs, LPNs, and specialty nurses to maintain licensure and grow skills.

MyFreeCE

Free and low-cost accredited CE courses for nurses covering clinical skills, pharmacology, infection control, and more.

 myfreece.com

Virtual Lecture Hall

Online nursing CE platform with board-certified instructors, specialty modules, and state approval verification.

 vlh.com

RN.com

Accredited CE for nurses with courses in critical care, pediatrics, emergency nursing, and leadership development.

 rn.com
CNA

CNA Continuing Education

Keep your CNA certification current with state-approved continuing education resources.

CNA CEUs

State-approved CE units for CNAs covering dementia care, HIPAA, safety, and patient rights.

 cnaceus.co

CNA Zone

Online CE platform for nursing assistants offering self-paced, affordable courses with state-approved certification tracking.

 cnazone.com
